title: 第一卷 第15章 明天有任务第一卷 第16章 许青禾女帝
lines: 刚走出笼子，秦烈就闻到了自己身上的腥臭味儿。
低头一看，衣服上全是小蜘蛛溅出来的墨绿色汁液。
好在这身衣服是旧衣服，一会儿直接丢掉就行了。
虽然衣服弄脏了，但是他得到的属性点实打实是真的。
赵老走到他身边，然后宣布他的成绩。
“秦烈，斩杀小蜘蛛四十七只。”
这个结果一宣布之后，练武场顿时就安静下来了。
四十七只。
赵魁才二十一只。
这已经不是略胜一筹了。
这都已经翻倍还多了。
秦烈的目光也在这群人身上扫了一圈。
刚才那些还喊他黑山镇来的傻子的那群人，这会儿也都不说话了。
果然无论身处什么时代，还是要用硬实力来说话。
他对这群人不感兴趣，而是提着手里的镇妖刀，径直走到了赵魁面前。
赵魁现在脸色非常难看，就跟吃了屎一样。
他看了看秦烈，又看了看笼子里面，嘴唇蠕动，想说些什么。
但是秦烈根本就不给他找机会的借口。
“服不服？”
这三个字一出口，练武场上的人都震惊了。
那可是赵魁呀！
居然有新人敢这么跟他说话！
不过想想刚才秦烈的战绩，大家也都收起了吃惊的表情。
赵魁脸色更难看了。
虽然不知道他想说什么，但是秦烈还是直接打断了他。
“刚才不是说我是黑山镇来的傻子吗？”
“现在你连我这个傻子都赢不了。”
“那你算什么？”
君子报仇，十年太晚。
赵魁的脸一下涨红了，握着镇妖刀的胳膊上面青筋暴跳，可以看出他的愤怒。
“秦烈，你别太狂了。”
秦烈听了之后，淡淡一笑。
“看你心气儿这么高，还以为你是个大人，结果没想到是个孩子。”
“我狂不重要，重要的是你当着这么多人的面输给了我，我就有资格狂。”
“以后如果还想嘲笑别人，得先掂量掂量自己有没有那个本事。”
说完之后，秦烈看都不看他一眼，然后就走到了陆沉身边。
只留下赵魁在原地咬着牙，脸色一阵青一阵白。
该还的嘴已经还回去了。再说下去就显得没意思了。
陆沉他们一群人就在旁边看着，也没有丝毫阻止的意思。
镇妖司本来就不是一个讲究温良恭俭让的地方。
content_en:
As soon as he walked out of the cage, Qin Lie smelled the fishy smell on his body.
When he looked down, his clothes were covered in dark green juice splashed by the little spider.
Fortunately, these clothes are old clothes, so you can just throw them away in a while.
Although his clothes were stained, the attribute points he received were real.
Mr. Zhao walked up to him and announced his results.
"Qin Lie, kill forty-seven little spiders."
As soon as the result was announced, the martial arts training ground suddenly became quiet.
Forty-seven.
Zhao Kuicai has twenty-one.
This is no longer slightly better.
This has more than doubled.
Qin Lie's eyes also swept around this group of people.
The group of people who just called him a fool from Montenegro Town stopped talking now.
Sure enough, no matter what era we are in, we still have to use hard power to speak.
He was not interested in this group of people, but walked straight to Zhao Kui with the demon-suppressing knife in his hand.
Zhao Kui's face is very ugly now, as if he had eaten shit.
He looked at Qin Lie and then inside the cage, his lips moving, trying to say something.
But Qin Lie didn't give him any excuse to find a chance.
"Are you convinced?"
As soon as these three words were spoken, everyone in the martial arts field was shocked.
That's Zhao Kui!
How dare a newcomer dare to talk to him like that!
But thinking about Qin Lie's performance just now, everyone also put away their surprised expressions.
Zhao Kui's face turned even darker.
"You..."
Although he didn't know what he wanted to say, Qin Lie interrupted him directly.
"Didn't you just say that I was a fool from Black Mountain Town?"
"Now you can't even beat me, a fool."
"Then who are you?"
A gentleman takes revenge, ten years is too late.
Zhao Kui's face suddenly turned red, and the veins on his arm holding the demon-suppressing knife were pulsing, showing his anger.
"Qin Lie, don't be too crazy."
After Qin Lie heard this, he smiled lightly.
"Looking at how high-spirited you are, I thought you were an adult, but you turned out to be a child."
"It doesn't matter that I'm crazy. What's important is that you lost to me in front of so many people, so I have the right to be crazy."
"If you still want to laugh at others in the future, you must first consider whether you have the ability."
After finishing speaking, Qin Lie walked over to Lu Chen without even looking at him.
Zhao Kui was left gritting his teeth on the spot, his face turning blue and white.
The mouth that should be repaid has been returned. It would be boring to talk about it any more.
Lu Chen and the others were watching from the side without any intention of stopping him.
The Demon Suppression Division is not a place that values ​​gentleness, courtesy and thrift.
